properties.notes: Disused farm buildings that form part of a rural farmstead site. Offers opportunity for conversion to residential use, in the context of a rural setting. Now identified for redevelopment. Permission has recently been granted for alteration and conversion of the vacant buildings to 5 dwellings (18/00503/FUL). Development has not commenced but is forecast for completion within the next 5 years.
